// Drifted variant of alchemy.run.ts for the drift-guard tests: drops the
// RUNTIME var, renames the worker, and adds a non-secret env entry that
// wrangler.jsonc does not declare.
import { Config } from "effect";
import * as Cloudflare from "alchemy/Cloudflare";

const secret = (name: string) =>
  process.env[name] === undefined ? undefined : Config.redacted(name);

export const Worker = Cloudflare.Worker("Worker", {
  name: "renamed-worker",
  main: "src/index.ts",
  compatibility: {
    date: "2026-06-01",
    flags: ["nodejs_compat"],
  },
  assets: {
    directory: "./public",
    notFoundHandling: "404-page",
  },
  workersDev: { enabled: true, previewsEnabled: false },
  crons: ["*/5 * * * *"],
  env: {
    GATEWAY_ID: "default",
    ORCHESTRATOR_MODEL: "@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct",
    CODING_MODEL: "google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite",
    INSTANCE_TYPE: "standard-1",
    ROGUE: "not-in-wrangler",
    AI: Cloudflare.Workers.AI(),
    CodingOrchestrator: Cloudflare.DurableObject("CodingOrchestrator", {
      className: "CodingOrchestrator",
    }),
    OpenCodeAgent: Cloudflare.DurableObject("OpenCodeAgent", {
      className: "OpenCodeAgent",
    }),
    Automations: Cloudflare.DurableObject("Automations", {
      className: "Automations",
    }),
    Sandbox: Cloudflare.Container("Sandbox", {
      name: "shiba-ai-coworker-sandbox",
      context: ".",
      dockerfile: "./Dockerfile",
      instanceType: "standard-1",
      maxInstances: 5,
    }),
    GITHUB_TOKEN: secret("GITHUB_TOKEN"),
  },
});

export type WorkerEnv = Cloudflare.InferEnv<typeof Worker>;
